message.content:
This document is a technical README and set of engineering notes for **Project Maya**, an open-source inference engine for large MoE models (GLM-5.3-Flash, DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017, MiniMax-M3.1-Flash). Key technical points:

**Architecture & memory model**
- Tiered expert storage: VRAM expert cache → pinned RAM tier → NVMe SSD, with CPU-lane computation of RAM-tier experts balanced against PCIe transfer.
- Multi-GPU layer splitting (up to 16 GPUs), auto split search priced by VRAM, expert coverage
